verdicts.reason: A: the logo floats alone in the middle with an unreadable 'MONOGRAPH GALLERY' wordmark, and the Shop button is centred under nothing, out of line with the text column on the right. The price sits above the product name, which reverses the original order, and the right third of the canvas is dead space. B: the left-to-right banner flow (watch, copy, CTA) is clean and the text is readable, but the logo has shrunk to an unrecognisable speck jammed against the bottom of the watch, so the brand is effectively lost. The price-above-name order is also inverted here. B wins narrowly because its layout only needs the logo fixed, while A's structure would have to be rebuilt.
